categories.main_business_segments: SmartSens Technology (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. primarily focuses on the research, design, and sales of high-performance CMOS image sensor chips. Its main business segments include smart security, smartphone imaging, and automotive electronics, with products widely applied in security surveillance, machine vision, smartphones, automotive electronics, and industrial sensing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs proprietary core technologies such as SFCPixel®, near-infrared sensitivity (NIR+), front-side illumination (FSI), back-side illumination (BSI), global shutter (GS), and advanced HDR pixel designs. It operates under a fabless model, outsourcing wafer manufacturing, packaging, and testing to specialized foundries while maintaining in-house final testing. The company continuously innovates in low-light imaging, high dynamic range, low noise, and automotive-grade chip design, with ongoing R&D in AI sensor platforms and high-resolution sensors.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading brands in smart security (e.g., Hikvision, Uniview), smartphone manufacturers (e.g., Xiaomi, OPPO, Vivo, Samsung), and major automotive OEMs (e.g., BYD, Geely, Chery, SAIC). The company serves global markets with a focus on high-end flagship smartphones, intelligent security systems, and automotive smart driving applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with significant domestic revenue growth and expanding international sales. It has subsidiaries and operations in Shanghai, Shenzhen, Hefei, Kunshan, Hong Kong, and the United States, serving customers worldwide including China and other countries.
categories.supply_chain_position: SmartSens operates as a fabless semiconductor company, focusing on chip design and sales while outsourcing wafer fabrication, packaging, and testing to foundries such as TSMC, Hefei Jinghe, and Samsung. It maintains strategic partnerships with these suppliers and has established a multi-regional supply chain to ensure production capacity and resilience.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous R&D investment to enhance product performance and expand its product portfolio across smart security, smartphones, and automotive electronics. It emphasizes innovation in imaging technologies, AI integration, low-light performance, automotive-grade reliability, and full-process localization of high-end smartphone sensors. Talent acquisition and retention, IP protection, and rapid product iteration aligned with customer needs are key strategic pillars.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of CMOS image sensor chips and related products. The company also earns income from providing technical development services. Sales channels include direct sales to major brand customers and distribution through authorized dealers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: SmartSens is a leading global player in the CMOS image sensor market, ranking first globally in security CIS shipments from 2020 to 2023, fourth globally and second domestically in automotive CIS shipments in 2023, and fifth globally in smartphone CIS shipments in 2024 with an 11.2% market share. It competes with major international CIS manufacturers such as Sony and OmniVision, leveraging its strong R&D, product differentiation, and domestic localization advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 5.97 billion, a 108.87% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders reaching RMB 392.7 million, a significant improvement from prior years. The company’s total assets grew by 27.41% to RMB 7.83 billion, and net assets increased by 11.97% to RMB 4.19 billion. The company maintains a healthy growth trajectory supported by expanding sales in smartphones, smart security, and automotive sectors.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: SmartSens emphasizes delivering high-quality, intelligent video solutions with superior imaging performance, including high sensitivity, low noise, wide dynamic range, and advanced shutter technologies. Its products offer competitive advantages in low-light and high-temperature environments, automotive-grade reliability, and cost-effective full-process localization. The company’s strong customer-centric approach, rapid product iteration, and comprehensive product matrix across multiple application scenarios differentiate it in the market.
